Description: Example for ReqCheck and test scenarios. Every group (tag group_*) shows one result of ReqCheck. Analyse one group with the search tag:group_..., or all but the inconsistent group with :NOT:group_inconsistent (an inconsistent set makes every other result meaningless). Uncheck 'with test scenarios', a .req file with test scenarios only checks them.

Test scenarios: import ignition_testscenarios.req on the page Test scenarios. They are about group_ok, analyse them with :NOT:group_inconsistent and 'with test scenarios' checked. Expected: 3/8 passed.
If the key is in the ignition and turned and the brake is pressed, the engine runs after at most 2 time units.
Without key the engine is off.
With an empty tank the engine is off.
The key can only be turned when it is in the ignition.
If the start button is pressed, the starter runs after at most 2 time units.
If the battery is low, the starter stays off for at least 5 time units.
If the car is locked and a door is not closed, the alarm sounds after at most 1 time unit.
When the car is locked, all doors are closed.
The car is always in battery saving mode.
In battery saving mode the lights are off.
